source: captured from Yamcs 5.13.5, an independent mission control system
note: Proximity-1 CRC-32 values computed by Yamcs, whose ProximityCrc32 is callable in isolation. The annex C worked example is already pinned in this corpus from the standard itself; these add an independent implementation agreeing on it and on a case the annex does not print.

encode.name: interop-proximity-crc32-check-value
encode.note: The nine ASCII digits under the Proximity-1 CRC-32. It is not any of the common CRC-32 variants — a different polynomial and a different initial value — so an implementation reaching for a standard library CRC-32 gets a plausible wrong answer here.

encode.name: interop-proximity-crc32-of-a-short-sequence
encode.note: Four ascending octets, with no symmetry to hide a byte-order error.
